labels.role: lower-left designation of secondary optical axis
upper-right designation of incident-ray straight continuation

lines_and_groups.kind: solid S through B toward Q
lines_and_groups.meaning: S-B is incident ray; B-Q is auxiliary unbent straight continuation, not actual refracted ray

lines_and_groups.kind: solid sloping P through O and C
solid B through C continuing up-right
dashed S_1 to B, collinear with B-C
lines_and_groups.meaning: backward extension only; not an actual ray moving from B to S_1

lines_and_groups.kind: vertical dashed line through C and F extending above and below

point_marks.shape: axis intersection aligned with dashed backward extension

shared_frame: One common principal axis through O and F, with the lens vertical through O. The secondary optical axis is oblique P-O-C, not the horizontal principal axis.

focal_plane.relation: Perpendicular to principal axis at current right focus F; C is its intersection with the secondary axis.

intersection_relationships: S_1, S, O, F lie on the principal horizontal axis in that left-to-right order.
S lies between the lens center O and the left-side focus position; no left F label is drawn.
B lies on the lens above O.
P-O-C is the oblique secondary optical axis and S-B-Q is parallel to it.
C is shared by the outgoing B-C ray, the secondary axis O-C, and the image-side focal plane C-F.
S_1, B, C are collinear, with S_1-B dashed and B-C solid.
S_1 is left of S and represents the virtual image found by backward construction, not a real-ray convergence.
Q marks the continuation of S-B, not C or a new physical image.
The focal plane through C must correspond to the current image-side principal focus F.
measurement_policy: Observed proportions are qualitative, not numerical physical measurements. No normalized coordinates or inferred distances have been used in this source inventory.
